name: v2.5.26-dev.1-alpha4
body:
## What's new in v2.5.26-dev.1-alpha4

- squeezelite: a stuck player no longer holds the reboot; the bundle shows why it stuck
- website: take the live demo button out of the hero
- website: a button to the live demo, high in the hero
- website: deploy to Cloudflare Pages with wrangler, not through gh-pages
- website: in line with main
- website: drop the Featurebase support chat
- Update SECURITY.md
- docs: README, ARCHITECTURE and the manual catch up with 2.5.25 and 2.5.26
- docs: README, ARCHITECTURE and the manual catch up with 2.5.25 and 2.5.26
- website: the new demo video, and PCs with a BIOS work too
- website: 25 new screenshots of the interface
- website: the new Osmium Sound mark, and the help band only once
- website: the ISO button points at v2.5.25
- website: the APK button points at companion 1.0.13
- website: the Android app is on Google Play, badge and QR up front
- website: supporters show up as cards with what they wrote
- website: thank Ko-fi supporters by name under the Ko-fi button
- website: the support band moves up under the hero
- website: an email to support opens a ticket, not a GitHub issue
- website: lead with help in the band after Install
- website: a support chat in place of the review form
- vu store: Titanium turns on its coil, with a needle long enough to reach (v3)
- vu store: the coil turns with the needle on Glossy and Titanium (v2)
- vu store: two more meters, a glossy black one and a titanium one
- site: the support link, counted on its way to Ko-fi
